data.additional_information:
We are looking for an Industrial Designer / Product Design Engineer to shape the form, ergonomics, user-experience, and product identity of our autonomous platforms and supporting systems — including ground control stations, remote controllers, payload pods, casings, and field-deployable equipment. The role bridges industrial design and engineering: visual form, material choice, ergonomics, manufacturability, and serviceability.

Job Responsibilities-
1. Concept Design & Ideation: Generate concepts, sketches, and design directions for autonomous system, ground stations, controllers, ruggedised cases, and other product touchpoints. Translate user needs and field-deployment constraints into industrial design briefs 
2. Form, Ergonomics & User Experience: Develop and refine product form, grip ergonomics, UI layout for hand-held and bench-top systems, and user-flow for field operators. Conduct ergonomic studies and operator-interaction reviews. 
3. CMF (Colour, Material, Finish): Define CMF strategy for each product line — military / industrial / commercial — including paints, anodisation, polymers, textures, and IP-rated finishes. 
4. Design Visualisation & Prototyping: Build photoreal renders, animations, and physical mockups for design reviews, client presentations, and trade shows. Lead foam / 3D-printed / vacuum-formed appearance models. 
.5. Design-to-Engineering Handover: Work closely with mechanical and manufacturing engineers to ensure industrial design intent is preserved through DFM, tooling, and production. Drive tolerance, parting-line, and surface-finish reviews on plastics and composites. 
6. Brand & Design Language: Build and maintain a coherent design language across Ayaan's product families. Develop guidelines for new product introductions to maintain brand consistency. 
7. User Research & Field Studies: Conduct field studies with operators, end-customers, and pilots to inform next-generation product design and improve operational usability. 
8.Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams for design intent, specifications, and technical concepts of the product. 
9. IP Development & Knowledge Building: Contribute to Patents and Internal design guidelines

Skills Required-
1. Strong portfolio demonstrating industrial design capability across hardware products — concept, form-development, prototyping, and final execution. 
2. Proficiency in design tools: SolidWorks / Fusion 360 Rhino, KeyShot, Blender, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop / Illustrator). 
3. Sound understanding of materials, manufacturing, and finishing processes — particularly for plastics, composites, sheet metal, and rugged enclosures. 
4. Working knowledge of human factors, ergonomics, and anthropometry.
5. Ability to sketch fluidly, render convincingly, and communicate design intent in reviews. 
6. Curiosity for emerging product categories and design trends in robotics, defence, and industrial automation. 
7. Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment. Willingness to learn from and contribute to the knowledge of others

Education Qualification-M.Des
Experience Required-0-2yrs

Please find below the additional important details regarding our Company Clauses & Policies:
1.NDA – Non-Disclosure Agreement
Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.
2.NCC – Non-Compete Clause
Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement. Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
